info.title: 369 Meter — Pay-per-call APIs for Agents
info.description: Four pay-per-call APIs served by one x402 gateway (x402 v1, USDC on Base, facilitator payai-public). Every paid route returns HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements when called without an X-PAYMENT header; the resource is served only after the facilitator confirms settlement. Prices: TextIntel $0.01/call, HookScore $0.01/call, TranslationCheck $0.02/call, GameFacts $0.03/call. PayTo: 0xA0A1ff293EF2FF051121674c8eAAd69570b25e6c (Base).
